body.title: Build the approval broker
body.summary: Add the daemon-owned broker (src/daemon/approval-broker.ts): a pending table keyed by requestId with a resolver and a 300 second timer, the set of open approval streams, ask(request) resolving to an answer or an ApprovalDenial (no-client at once with no stream open, timed-out at expiry, declined, cancelled when the caller's signal aborts, which also sends the subscribers a cancel frame), answer(requestId, decision) where the first answer wins and an unknown or already answered id is refused, replay of still-pending requests to a late subscriber, and no-client for every pending request when the last stream closes. It never rejects.
acceptanceChecks: ask() with no open stream resolves no-client without waiting
an unanswered request resolves timed-out at its expiry and a late answer is ignored
two subscribers: the first answer wins and the second is told accepted false
closing the last stream resolves every pending request to no-client
an aborted caller signal resolves cancelled and removes the request
the broker holds no state across a restart and never rejects
